questions.q: According to Graham, what are the three principles of intelligent investing?
a: Analyze long-term, diversify, focus on safe steady returns
Buy low, sell high, hold for at least ten years
Follow market trends, minimize taxes, use leverage
Pick growth stocks, time the market, avoid dividends
questions.why: From the lesson on three principles of intelligent investing.

questions.q: What does Warren Buffett list as Rule No. 1 for investing?
a: Never lose money
Always diversify your portfolio
Buy only what you understand
Invest for the long term only
questions.why: From the lesson on three principles, citing Buffett's two rules.

questions.q: How does Graham describe Mr. Market's behavior?
a: Unpredictable, not very clever, prone to mood swings
Consistently rational and always fair
Driven by insider information and data
Steady, methodical, and always accurate
questions.why: From the Mr. Market lesson describing his key traits.

questions.q: What is Graham's formula investing more commonly called?

Value investing
Index fund investing
Momentum trading

questions.q: What does formula investing require an investor to do?
a: Set a fixed budget and invest it regardless of price
Wait for the best price before making any purchase
Adjust the amount based on current market conditions
Only invest when stock prices drop below a threshold
